records.title: TextNCA: Neural Cellular Automata for Language Modeling via Hierarchical Local Attention
records.reason: The body reports 53k tokens/s for Hier-TextNCA versus 138k tokens/s for Transformer-6L at batch 32 / length 512, and says TextNCA is not computationally Pareto-superior at this scale. Its test-time iteration knob carries substantial perplexity cost.

records.title: One QK Channel, Many Sources: Tracing Low-Precision Attention Collapse
records.reason: The abstract diagnoses numerical attention collapse during low-precision Transformer training; it does not address inference/serving.

records.title: From Information to Delegation: Mapping Human-AI Financial Decision Making
records.reason: The study measures human delegation in financial AI use from interaction logs, not a model inference optimization.

records.title: IACM-RL: Intent-Aware Context Management and Reinforcement Learning for Complex Tool Invocation under Dynamic Intent Fluctuations
records.reason: IACM-RL focuses on tool-intent robustness and training trajectories for agent API execution, not model-serving efficiency.

records.title: PromptPath: Prompt-Adaptive Computational Pathways for In-Context Learning
records.reason: PromptPath changes computational pathways for in-context learning/interpretability, with no efficiency objective or inference cost result in the abstract.
